github.host.rejected.credentials.text: A GitHub host can’t hold a user name, password or token.
github.host.rejected.credentials.note: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): it has an @ (user name, password or token before the host). Combwork never stores credentials there.

github.host.rejected.empty.text: Enter a host name, such as github.com or yourcompany.ghe.com.
github.host.rejected.empty.note: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): the host is empty. Keep the example host names.

github.host.rejected.invalid.text: That isn’t a host name, such as github.com or yourcompany.ghe.com.
github.host.rejected.invalid.note: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): the text isn’t a valid host name. Keep the example host names.

github.host.rejected.notCloud.text: Copilot signs in on github.com or a GHE.com host (yourcompany.ghe.com). For your own GitHub Enterprise Server, choose its Copilot proxy instead.
github.host.rejected.notCloud.note: An error saving where Copilot signs in (HI-2779): the host given is a GitHub Enterprise Server host, where cloud Copilot can’t sign in. GHE.com is GitHub’s product name; Copilot proxy: GitHub Enterprise Server’s preview. Keep the host names.

github.host.rejected.path.text: A GitHub host is only its name, without a path after it.
github.host.rejected.path.note: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): it has a path after the host name (/org/repo).

github.host.rejected.port.text: A GitHub host is only its name, without a port.
github.host.rejected.port.note: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): it has :port after the host name.

github.host.rejected.query.text: A GitHub host is only its name, without ? or # after it.
github.host.rejected.query.note: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): it has a query string or fragment. Keep ? and #.

github.host.rejected.scheme.text: A GitHub host is a name such as github.com, or an https:// address: no other scheme.
github.host.rejected.scheme.note: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): it starts with a scheme other than https:// (http://, ssh://…). Keep github.com and https:// as they are.

github.hosts.copilot.note: A setting (HI-2779): the GitHub host GitHub Copilot signs in on, which can differ from the repositories’ host.

github.hosts.copilotDesc.text: Usually the same as the GitHub host. With repositories on GitHub Enterprise Server, choose where your Copilot licence is: github.com or your GHE.com host.
github.hosts.copilotDesc.note: What the setting “Copilot signs in on” is for (HI-2779). GHE.com is GitHub’s product name.

github.hosts.host.note: A setting (HI-2779): the host of the repositories: github.com, a GHE.com host (yourcompany.ghe.com) or a GitHub Enterprise Server.

github.hosts.hostDesc.text: github.com, your GHE.com host (yourcompany.ghe.com) or your GitHub Enterprise Server’s name. Only the name: no path, port or token.
github.hosts.hostDesc.note: What the setting “GitHub host” takes (HI-2779). GHE.com is GitHub’s product name; keep the host names.
